hints.title: Subarray Product Remainders
hints.text: For each position, maintain the count of contiguous subsegments ending at that position grouped by their product remainder modulo k.

hints.title: Modular Transition Map
hints.text: Multiplying by the current number transitions each previous remainder r to (r * num) modulo k.

hints.title: Global Remainder Aggregation
hints.text: Accumulate counts across all ending positions to form the complete remainder frequency array.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: DP table of size k is updated at each element in O(K) time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all O(N^2) subarrays takes quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Modular DP rolls forward in O(K) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use modular arithmetic in DP to aggregate subarray product remainders.
